about: Lead QA engineer with more than two decades of hands-on testing across enterprise platforms and distributed teams. I specialize in building durable test strategies, coaching junior testers, and turning flaky pipelines into trustworthy quality gates. I care most about shipping software that behaves the same in production as it did in review.
hobbies: Restoring vintage radios and competitive orienteering on weekends.

experiences.description: Owned the end-to-end quality strategy for a multi-tenant billing platform and led a team of nine testers. Introduced risk-based test planning that cut escaped defects significantly and stabilized a previously brittle release pipeline. Mentored engineers on exploratory testing and defect triage.

Coordinated cross-border testing efforts between regional offices and the core product team. Designed regression suites for a logistics tracking product and reviewed automation coverage before each milestone. Acted as the quality liaison for stakeholder demos.

Validated complex workflows for an order-management product spanning several user roles. Built reusable test data sets and documented edge cases that fed directly into the developer handbook. Partnered closely with support to reproduce field-reported issues.

Executed functional and integration testing for a document-processing suite used by large clients. Helped establish the first formal bug lifecycle and severity rubric for the team. Reduced re-test cycles by clarifying acceptance criteria with product owners.

Performed manual verification of release candidates for a consumer scheduling application. Tracked defects through resolution and verified fixes against original reproduction steps. Contributed checklists that shortened onboarding for new testers.

Supported senior testers in validating desktop utilities and recording reproducible defect reports. Learned structured test-case authoring and basic smoke-testing routines. Maintained the shared archive of test evidence and screenshots.

projects.title: Portfolio Risk Analytics Rollout
projects.summary: Acted as business analyst for a phased deployment of a portfolio risk reporting tool at an investment firm. Translated trader and compliance requirements into clear acceptance criteria and validated automated provisioning of the reporting environment. Bridged the gap between operations staff and the engineering team to keep the rollout on schedule.
